production.note: Calendar years 2016-2022 (owner decision, 8 October 2026; home-market record). Classic.com: 'produced by the Swedish manufacturer from 2016–2022'; automoli also gives 'Production 2016–2022' (automoli-regera). Koenigsegg: 'ONLY 80 REGERA PRODUCED IN TOTAL', 'At launch in 2015' (koenigsegg-regera). The Regera was also sold in the US (the held entry noted EPA ratings for MY2019-2020 and US deliveries 2018-2022); US model years were not fully sourced, so the owner chose the home market.

body.note: Two-door, two-seat hypercar; recorded as Coupe like the other Koenigseggs (a database calling it a Targa uses no Koenigsegg name).

displacementL.note: Koenigsegg: '5.0L V8'. The cc figure was not on a Koenigsegg page opened (bore 92 mm, stroke 95.25 mm).

fuel.note: Autofácil (Daniel Navarro, 5 March 2015): 'Que sea un híbrido enchufable', the car 'puede enchufarse para recargar' and 'En modo eléctrico es capaz de hacer unos 50Km'. Koenigsegg calls it a '1,500 hp hybrid system' with an '800 Volt 4.5 kWh' battery (koenigsegg-regera-specs).

drivetrain.note: Koenigsegg: 'KDD provides direct drive to the rear axle from the ICE'; electric motors 'One on each rear wheel and one on the crank shaft'.

transmission.note: Koenigsegg: 'Koenigsegg Direct Drive' (KDD), which 'completely replaces the combustion engine's (ICE) traditional transmission/gearbox' (koenigsegg-regera): a single fixed ratio.

powerHp.note: Koenigsegg's combined rating on E85. Quote (Koenigsegg technical specifications): "Combined power: Over 1500 hp (E85) or 1.11 MW"; model page: "1500 HP Total Output" (koenigsegg-regera). Engine alone '1100 hp at 7800 rpm' (1,500 hp on E85 per the same page); electric '700 hp'. Stored as published (powerStandard Other, as for the Agera R). 1.11 MW x 1.34102 = 1,489 hp; the published 1,500 hp is used.

weightLb.note: Step 1 (manufacturer curb weight). Quote (Koenigsegg technical specifications): "Curb weight, including all fluids and a full fuel tank: 1590 kg"; model page: "1590 Kg Curb weight". 1,590 x 2.20462 = 3,505.3, rounded to 3,505 lb. Dry weight 1,420 kg.
